body:
Drawbacks
Child of Nature
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 218, Faiths of Balance pg. 11, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 332, Ultimate Campaign pg. 63
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Gozreh
The wild places are your home, and provide everything you need to be happy. You gain a +2 trait bonus on Survival checks, and Survival is a class skill for you.
